bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by designating gender as the sensitive attribute in the UCI Adult (income prediction) and Bias-in-Bios (profession classification) datasets, and measuring fairness via Demographic Parity (ΔDP) and the True Positive Rate gap (GAP) across gender groups.

Evaluated by designating age as the sensitive attribute in the Heritage Health dataset, dividing patients into eight groups based on age ranges, and measuring Demographic Parity (ΔDP) across the groups.
